The draft PubMed strategy is saved as a **single line** in [final_strategy.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-1ed0294b794a32e7/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T105556Z/final_strategy.txt). The full audit is in [audit.md](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-1ed0294b794a32e7/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T105556Z/work/audit.md).

The final query returns **2,737 records** through the 2022-05-10 publication cutoff. It retrieved all **9 of 9** screened development records; this is relative recall against a small, non-independent set, not a sensitivity estimate. The scope assumes you want clinical MSC studies across sources, including studies of a single source, with source compared during screening.

The internal critique was same-context, not independent PRESS peer review. Have an information specialist review the draft before use.
